verdict.rationale: Capacities' API uses a single Bearer token (OAuth2-style) for the whole space with no documented scoping, permission granularity, or per-agent least-privilege credential issuance; no evidence of scoped tokens, role-based API keys, or revocable per-agent credentials exists in the docs. Missing for 10: scoped/permission-limited token creation, per-agent credential management, granular access controls for API keys.
